changeinfo.changes:
Standby Support Restored:
New Sony PAF interface that is cleaner and easier to read. Larger text and controls for better visibility on the PS Vita screen. Redesigned streaming mode presentation with distinct colors. Added camera streaming with two native resolution profiles: 640×480 at 60 FPS 480×272 at 30 FPS Added support for both front and rear cameras, with switching via the L/R buttons. Added support for the PS Vita microphone during camera streaming. Camera streaming now uses native resolutions directly, without resizing. Improved compatibility with the Windows Camera app and OBS. Improved camera mode stability, especially with the 480×272 profile. Improved memory management when switching or stopping streaming modes. Camera, microphone, and audio resources are now released when streaming stops. Improved USB recovery after streaming errors. Screen On and Screen Off modes are now clearly identified. In Screen Off mode, disconnecting the USB cable restores the display, while reconnecting it turns the display off again. Improved standby and wake-up behavior during streaming. The interface now clearly displays the active source: screen, front camera, or rear camera. Improved installation, updating, and detection of VitaUSBStream, HomebrewUpdate, and HomebrewPatch. Various stability improvements and minor fixes.
